children.title: CAJAL
children.description: , A fine-tuned open-source LLM (Qwen3.6 base) specialized for generating publication-ready scientific papers. Runs 100% locally with 4B–9B parameters, ranked #3 on scientific paper benchmarks, surpassing most SOTA cloud models including Claude Sonnet 4.6 competitors.

repo_info.description: CAJAL — Local scientific paper generator. Qwen 27B fine-tuned for academic writing. AI Tribunal peer review. 6x4 CognitionBoard. 2.7x token compression. Runs offline on RTX 3090. Apache 2.0.
